points.point: Why the 4 photos posted to the feed instead of the Story
points.sentence: If you attach multiple images to a Story, Blotato publishes them as a regular feed post instead.

points.point: Instagram Story with 4 photos (multiple images in one Story)
points.sentence: An Instagram Story accepts only one image or one video per post.

verdict.reason: The customer attached four photos to one Instagram Story, and this entry states both that a Story accepts only one image or video per post and that multiple images to a Story are published as a regular feed post.
